description: Returns a backlinks profile summary (total backlinks, referring domains, referring pages, rank) plus the top referring domains by backlink count. CHARGES CREDITS ON THE PAID DATA PROVIDER (~200-500 typical): two lookups per call, the summary and one page of referring domains. UNAVAILABLE ON THE DEFAULT FREE DATA PROVIDER: a backlink graph needs a proprietary web-scale crawl index, so every method of this surface throws SEO_DATA_UNAVAILABLE there and nothing is charged. That error means the question was never asked — never report it as a site with no backlinks. Self-hosted deployments also need the Backlinks API enabled on their DataForSEO account. The two halves count DIFFERENT populations: the summary totals are unfiltered, while the referring-domain list has domains above the spam-score threshold filtered out. Do not present the listed domains as the top slice of the summary total, and do not subtract one from the other.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

scope.description: 'domain' analyzes the whole domain; 'page' analyzes a specific URL. Defaults to 'domain'.

target.description: Domain or URL to analyze (e.g. 'example.com' or 'https://example.com/blog').

name: get_backlinks_overview
